## Evidence

List checks and outcomes. For experiments, include immutable config/data/model revisions, run IDs, accessible artifact locations, spend, and completion status. Separate estimates from measured results.

## Handoff

- [ ] README current status and dated handoff log updated.

- [ ] Existing runs were checked before launching duplicate work.
- [ ] Data separation and frozen-test protocol preserved, or a versioned amendment linked.
- [ ] No credentials or large runtime artifacts included.
